name: Agent Fleet
author: Daniluvatar
description: One bar widget for your AI subscription allowance. Shows the Codex 5-hour and weekly percent used in the bar, with Hermes agent activity in the panel.

barWidget.description: Codex subscription allowance in the bar: tier, 5-hour and weekly percent used, and the reset countdown, plus recent Hermes activity per agent and model. Activity counts only — not a share of your allowance.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Matches the first-party Agents widget default. The refresh that runs when you open the panel is separate and immediate.

schema.label: Show percent used in the bar
schema.description: The bar shows the highest-used window. Turn off for an icon-only bar.

schema.label: Default attribution window
schema.description: Which window the [ Weekly ] [ 5-hour ] attribution selector opens on. The selector can always switch; both windows stay cached, and this changes no data.

schema.label: Show recent completed segments
schema.description: The compact, strictly read-only list of recently completed attribution segments. Hiding it only hides the section — it never affects the local segments store.
